services.name: SUP Yoga
services.desc: Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP) is the fastest growing water sport in the world. It’s a great way to get on the water and have fun while increasing balance, coordination, core stability, strength, and endurance. Plus, it’s an outdoor activity the whole family will enjoy! Take your favorite fitness and wellness practices to the board in a nurturing, outdoor studio. Soak up the therapeutic benefits of being surrounded by water, using your paddleboard as a fun balance trainer improving core strength and stabilization.
